environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate in private subnet. PostgreSQL RDS instance (db.r5.large) with app_user having SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on assets schema. Service exposed via internal ALB with no WAF attached. ECS task role has basic CloudWatch and ECR pull permissions. No query-level firewall or pgAudit configured. Database connection uses app_user with standard privileges.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15.4, app_user has full DML on public schema
config.network: Internal ALB -> ECS tasks in private subnet, no WAF
config.db_permissions: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_user
